title: Professional Certificate Course in Project Scheduling Tools and Techniques
description: Understanding the basics of project scheduling, focusing on key concepts such as the Work Breakdown Structure, activities and tasks and activity duration estimation in Critical Chain Project Management.
longDescription: Understanding the WBS, activities and task-the basic building blocks. Activity duration in Critical chain project management. Estimating the resource requirement. Calculating critical path float. Understanding the basics of project scheduling with a focus on key concepts such as the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), activities and tasks, activity duration estimation in Critical Chain Project Management, resource requirement estimation, and calculating critical path float. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following,
courseDetails: This course aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of the basic building blocks of project management, including the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), activities, and tasks. Learners will learn about activity duration estimation using Critical Chain Project Management techniques and resource requirements estimation. Additionally, participants will learn how to calculate critical path float and use it to effectively manage project timelines.
